Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Redesigned Customize with compact Review controls, a selected-theme preview, Dark/Light filtering, fixed-width theme tiles, and collapsed advanced colors. Moved Fun Mode to the header and Timers back to Review. Better Deaths now starts closed. Fixed killing-hit HP labels to show post-hit HP and made HP bar labels consistent.
